summary: GH Research PLC filed a Form 6-K to provide its shareholders with notice of the annual general meeting scheduled for June 25, 2026. The agenda includes re-election of directors and ratification of auditors. No special-situation event such as merger, tender offer, or restructuring is described. The filing is a routine corporate governance update with no transaction terms, board recommendations on M&A, or advisory roles. This is a standard AGM notice with no special-situation content.
